 now=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec='seconds').replace('+00:00','Z')
 result={

 'evidence':[

 ],'residual_blockers':[]}
 authpath=tmp/'auth44.json';respath=tmp/'result44.json'
 authpath.write_text(json.dumps(auth,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')

 validator=root/'control/validate_records.py'
 for check,ar in [('transition-result-current',[str(respath)]),('transition-pair-current',[str(authpath),str(respath)])]:
